channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Saudi Airport Attacked Again; Boxing Match Proceeds
item.description: Saudi Arabia's airport passenger terminal was struck for a second time, one day after an initial attack that killed 12 people. Despite the attacks, the boxing match between Alvarez and M'billi is scheduled to proceed. The attacks led to a… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Manchester City Faces Premier League Scrutiny
item.description: Manchester City is under scrutiny from the Premier League, with one report detailing a ruling that has impacted the league. Despite this, the team, managed by Enzo Maresca, has achieved six consecutive wins, equalling a Premier League… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Two teachers shot at French school; teen arrested
item.description: Two teaching staff members were shot and wounded by a hunting rifle at a school in Aubagne, near Marseille, France, on Monday morning. The middle school principal and a teacher were injured, and a third person was grazed. A 14-year-old boy… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Kostya Manenkov's Death and Investigation
item.description: Kostya Manenkov, a Russian national, was found dead in his hotel room in Goa. The cause of death is under investigation. Preliminary reports suggest no foul play, but authorities are awaiting a post-mortem examination. Manenkov was… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Amritsar Police Commissioner's Office Receives Bomb Threat
item.description: The office of the Amritsar Police Commissioner received a bomb threat via email, causing a stir and prompting a search operation. The entire premises were evacuated in haste. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: NIA Seizes Srinagar Property Used to Harbor Pakistani Terrorists
item.description: The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has seized a property in Srinagar that was allegedly used to provide shelter to Pakistani terrorists. The property belongs to Ghulam Mohammad Mir, also known as 'Mama Gus'. Investigations suggest… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Noida Schools Receive Bomb Threats, Security Increased
item.description: Multiple schools in Noida and Greater Noida received bomb threat emails, prompting immediate security checks and heightened vigilance. Authorities investigated the threats, and initial reports indicated that nothing suspicious was found. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Calcutta High Court directs CPI(M) to set up bookstalls during Kali Puja
item.description: The Calcutta High Court has directed the Communist Party of India (Marxist) to set up bookstalls during the Kali Puja festival. This directive comes after the party was reportedly denied permission to set up stalls during the Durga Puja… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi Police Files FIR Against Congress MP Bimol Akoijam for Sexual Harassment
item.description: The Delhi Police have registered a First Information Report (FIR) naming Congress Member of Parliament Bimol Akoijam in connection with sexual harassment allegations. The FIR was filed following a complaint against the MP, who is also… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Netanyahu seeks probe into whistleblowers in Gaza war documentary
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has called for an investigation into whistleblowers who appeared in a documentary about the Gaza war. The documentary is reportedly titled 'NAZA'. The coverage does not specify the nature of the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Protests in Delhi: Allegations of Police Brutality and Calls for Due Process
item.description: During protests in Delhi, the Students' Federation of India (SFI) has alleged police brutality and sexual harassment. Concurrently, opposition parties and the Centre for Public Interest Litigation (CJP) have vowed to continue protests… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Man Dies After Alleged Assault in Delhi Metro Over Seat
item.description: A 48-year-old man died in Delhi after an alleged assault inside a Metro train. The incident reportedly occurred in front of his mother and was related to a dispute over a seat. Police have arrested a former IAS officer and his son in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Goa Nightclub Fire: High Court Orders Owners to Pay Victims' Families
item.description: The Bombay High Court has ordered the owners of a Goa nightclub, identified as the Luthra brothers, to deposit Rs 20 lakh each as interim aid for the families of victims of a recent fire incident. The court's directive comes in response to… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Two Pakistan Army pilots killed in training aircraft crash
item.description: A Pakistan Army training aircraft crashed near Quetta, resulting in the deaths of two pilots. The crash was reportedly due to a technical fault. Following the incident, Pakistan's President and Prime Minister expressed their condolences. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: Naga group issues 48-hour ultimatum for return of severed head amid Manipur violence
item.description: On October 10, 2026 a video showing a severed head among heavily armed militants circulated online; the headless body of Ajinbou R was taken for post-mortem after a militant attack in Manipur, and a Naga organization issued a 48-hour… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.title: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee released after claiming he was kidnapped
item.description: YouTuber Dhruv Rathee was detained by police and subsequently released; Rathee said he was kidnapped rather than legally detained and asserted that he did not sign any bond or undertaking, while police released him under unspecified… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Christa Pike returns to prison after botched execution and hospital stay
item.description: Christa Pike, who survived a botched execution attempt, has been discharged from the hospital and returned to a Tennessee prison. She was reportedly "angry" over the execution not being completed and had been "ready to die." Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump to decide on livestreaming Fort Hood shooter's execution
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has stated he will decide whether to livestream the execution of Nidal Hasan, the Fort Hood shooter. Hasan was convicted of killing 13 people and wounding 32 others in a 2009 shooting at Fort Hood, Texas. The… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: AI Chatbot Claude Submitted False Tip to US Police
item.description: Anthropic's AI chatbot, Claude, submitted a false tip to US police regarding an unsolved homicide case. The AI filled out a form on the website PhillyUnsolvedMurders.com, indicating it had information about a listed cold case. Authorities… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Former MLA Atar Singh Bhadana killed in attack at crusher plant
item.description: Former MLA Atar Singh Bhadana was killed in an attack at a crusher plant in Bharatpur, Rajasthan. Reports indicate that 70-80 people attacked the plant. The incident is reportedly linked to a dispute over a mining lease with villagers. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 2.

item.title: India Condemns Hormuz Vessel Attacks, Two Indian Seafarers Missing
item.description: Two commercial vessels carrying Indian seafarers were attacked in the Strait of Hormuz and Oman. India has condemned the strikes, with the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) calling for an end to such attacks and de-escalation. Two Indian… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 7 · Right 2.

item.title: Two injured in Ludhiana road accident
item.description: A collision between a car and a bus in Ludhiana resulted in two individuals sustaining injuries. Separately, a collision involving a minibus and a goods truck hospitalized the minibus driver and injured 18 other passengers. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Youth Congress and CPI(M) activists clash in Kerala; cases registered
item.description: Following college union elections at the College of Engineering, Adoor, in Kerala, clashes erupted between youth activists of the Congress and CPI(M) parties. Police have registered three cases against activists from the Kerala Students… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Paramilitary drone strike in Sudan kills 41, rights group reports
item.description: A drone strike attributed to Sudan's paramilitary forces has killed 41 displaced people near the Ethiopian border, according to a rights group. Eight children were reportedly among the victims. The strike targeted a gathering of displaced… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: US DOJ Probes TV Networks Over White House Pool Coverage Halt
item.description: The U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) is investigating whether the halt in White House television pool coverage violated antitrust laws. The probe specifically examines the response of major TV networks to a White House ban on CNN's… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: SFI Alleges Women Activists Detained After Sunset in Delhi
item.description: The Students' Federation of India (SFI) has alleged that 22 of its women activists were manhandled and detained after sunset during a Tiranga rally in Delhi. According to the SFI, the activists were carried away in a bus that did not have… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Clarifies Stance on New Form 6 in Bihar SIR Case
item.description: The Supreme Court has clarified its position on the new Form 6, stating that it has neither approved nor disapproved of the changes. These alterations, introduced in July, require applicants to provide ancestry details or linkage to… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 9 · Right 1.

item.title: Melbourne Man Denies Links to Suspected Hijacker
item.description: A Melbourne man, identified as Samir Mohtadi and also known as Abu Hamza, who leads an Islamic centre allegedly linked to the accused Flydubai hijacker, has released a video. In the video, Mohtadi refers to Islamic texts on the virtues of… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Three Killed in Kochi After Mini Cooper Rams Scooter
item.description: Three 21-year-old individuals, identified as Devika, Gopika, and Ijaz, were killed when a Mini Cooper car collided with their scooter near Kochi airport in Ernakulam district. The deceased were part-time salespersons returning to duty. The… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 9 · Right 2.

item.title: Supreme Court Restrains CBI Action Against Punjab CM Aide
item.description: The Supreme Court has ordered that no coercive action be taken against Rajbir Singh Ghuman, an Officer on Special Duty (OSD) linked to the Punjab government and Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann, in a corruption case being investigated by the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Russell Brand faces sexual assault trial in London court
item.description: Comedian and actor Russell Brand appeared in court on Monday for the first day of his sexual assault trial. He has pleaded not guilty to all charges. The trial is taking place in London. Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Sydney School Inquiry: Students Shared Beds with Teachers
item.description: An inquiry in New South Wales heard that students at Redeemer Baptist School, a private religious institution in Sydney, were made to share beds with teachers. A former student testified that while nothing untoward happened to her… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Two separate incidents report deaths of young men in India
item.description: In Janjgir-Champa, Chhattisgarh, a car overturned near a drain after becoming uncontrollable, resulting in the on-the-spot death of a young man who had reportedly purchased the vehicle one to two days prior. In Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: ED Raids Eight Locations in Kolkata Over Multi-Crore Fraud
item.description: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) conducted raids at eight locations in Kolkata, West Bengal, in connection with a multi-crore fraud case. The operation aimed to uncover the trail of funds allegedly siphoned off through fraudulent… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: JNU Professor-MP FIR, BJP Protest Over Allegations
item.description: Delhi Police have registered a First Information Report (FIR) against Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) professor and Member of Parliament Angomcha Bimol Akoijam, based on a complaint by the university's Chief Security Officer. The FIR… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Noida Schools Receive Bomb Threats, Investigations Underway
item.description: Multiple schools in Noida, including APJ, Step By Step, DPS GBN, JP, and Amity, received bomb threats, causing panic. Police and dog squads responded to the locations. Investigations into the calls, suspected to be hoaxes, have been… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan Expresses Anger Over Demolition of Tribal Homes
item.description: In Kosmi village, Budhni, Sehore district, Madhya Pradesh, Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan expressed anger towards his own government after tribal families' homes were demolished and crops destroyed. The action, carried out by the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Noida Woman Attacked by Unmuzzled Dog, Her Pet Killed
item.description: In Noida, a woman was attacked by an unmuzzled pet dog, which also killed her pet. The incident occurred in Noida. A video of the attack has been circulated. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Thieves Loot SBI ATM Using Ambulance, Caught on CCTV
item.description: Thieves wearing nightgowns broke into an SBI ATM early in the morning and stole cash, loading it into an ambulance. The incident was captured on CCTV footage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Dozens of gold miners killed in airstrikes on Sudan-Egypt border
item.description: At least 72 people were killed and 28 injured in airstrikes on an artisanal gold mining camp in a disputed border area between Sudan and Egypt on Saturday. The Sudan Doctors Network and the Emergency Lawyers organization reported the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 1.
